item.title: Gauteng, Free State, North West and Mpumalanga braces as level five weather warning issued
item.description: A level five weather warning has been issued for Gauteng, Free State, North West, western Limpopo, and the Highveld of Mpumalanga, with severe thunderstorms and potential flooding expected, while a level two warning and fire danger alerts are in place for other parts of South Africa. Seen here: SuperSport Park on Saturday, moments before a heavy storm moved in. Picture: Farryn Sherman
